quarterly_data.quarter: Samsung Electro-Mechanics press release: Samsung Electro-Mechanics and NVIDIA Announce Strategic (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Strategic partnership with NVIDIA for ABF package substrates: the two companies will jointly invest in expanding dedicated ABF substrate manufacturing facilities, with dedicated production lines at the Sejong and Busan sites in South Korea, under a multi-year supply agreement. The agreement covers substrates for NVIDIA's compute chipsets and for high-speed networking switches; deliveries start in 2026 and the volume supplied to NVIDIA is expected to increase at a double-digit annual rate over the multi-year period. CEO Duck-Hyun Chang: by combining its advanced FC-BGA manufacturing with its high-reliability MLCC expertise, the company will ensure NVIDIA's AI platforms are delivered to the market on time; the release says advanced packaging embeds passive components such as MLCCs and silicon capacitors within the substrate.
quarterly_data.figure: multi-year supply from 2026; volume growth at a double-digit annual rate
